meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes, so let's start with who decided on the zero, and whether anyone spoke to Owen before it went in.
I'm here. Who decided on the zero?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn, that you tell me in writing who decided to enter it without calling me first, and that nothing be placed on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: she stayed at her opening position, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an answer about who decided it, and nothing on his record, so the fair outcome (a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record, procedure 4.4) was never reached.
What moved her: nothing, because you only thanked her for coming and never put a document or a fact in front of her.
What cost ground: you let her take the floor with her question twice and gave her no answer, so she kept the initiative the whole time.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fights so hard.
Try next time: after she asks who decided on the zero, answer in one sentence that you entered it before calling her and that was wrong, then put one dated document in front of her.
